name: ice-rink-web
description: Reusable multi-site rental frontend powered by Pumpkin CMS

scripts.validate:static:ice: cross-env PUMPKIN_RENDER_MODE=static SITE_KEY=ice-rink-rentals STATIC_CONTENT_SOURCE=seed-sites node scripts/static-publish.mjs validate
scripts.validate:static:roller: cross-env PUMPKIN_RENDER_MODE=static SITE_KEY=roller-rink-rentals STATIC_CONTENT_SOURCE=seed-sites node scripts/static-publish.mjs validate
scripts.build:static:ice: cross-env PUMPKIN_RENDER_MODE=static SITE_KEY=ice-rink-rentals STATIC_CONTENT_SOURCE=seed-sites next build
scripts.build:static:roller: cross-env PUMPKIN_RENDER_MODE=static SITE_KEY=roller-rink-rentals STATIC_CONTENT_SOURCE=seed-sites next build
scripts.export:static:ice: npm run validate:static:ice && npm run build:static:ice && cross-env PUMPKIN_RENDER_MODE=static SITE_KEY=ice-rink-rentals STATIC_CONTENT_SOURCE=seed-sites node scripts/static-publish.mjs generate
scripts.export:static:roller: npm run validate:static:roller && npm run build:static:roller && cross-env PUMPKIN_RENDER_MODE=static SITE_KEY=roller-rink-rentals STATIC_CONTENT_SOURCE=seed-sites node scripts/static-publish.mjs generate
